transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, nice to meet you. I'm here because... for almost two years now, I've been completely unable to shake this certainty about what's happening at my job. 

I'm a composer and director, and after a big commission we did, a few people in my ensemble started quietly undermining my work. It's subtle stuff—using sudden schedule changes, shifting seating choices around, making these little comments during rehearsals. They always have an excuse, you know? They'll show me emails or notes that supposedly explain it all away, but... I know what they're actually doing. It's been going on for a long time, so I guess I'm here to talk about that.
When you say you know what they're actually doing, do you mean you believe they are intentionally working against you as part of a coordinated plan?

Yeah, exactly. I mean, like I was just saying, I have this absolute certainty about it. Ever since that commission almost two years ago, it's clear to me that it's intentional. They're using those schedule mix-ups, the seating changes, the little comments during rehearsals... they're doing all of it to quietly undermine my work. 

So yes, it feels very coordinated. Even when they try to show me an email or some note that supposedly explains it away as just a normal mistake or a coincidence, I just... I know it's deliberate. I can't shake that certainty.
Have you ever experienced any unusual perceptions, like hearing voices or seeing things that others don't, or felt sensations on your body that don't seem to have a physical cause?
No, I haven't experienced anything like that. I don't hear voices or see things that aren't there, and I don't feel any strange sensations. It's just the situation at work that I'm dealing with.
Do you believe these people in your ensemble are part of a larger group or organization working against you, or is it limited to just them?

No, I don't think it's some big, shadowy organization or anything like that. It's just... it's just them. The people in my ensemble. I haven't seen any sign that it goes beyond the people I work with every day. It's just that specific group of individuals who are trying to sabotage my work.
